simplefarming.title: Simple Farming
text.autoconfig.simplefarming.option.pre:
If enabled, players with Feather Falling
boots will not trample farmland. Default:
true.
text.autoconfig.simplefarming.option.sha:
If enabled, swords and axes with Sharpness
cut and swing through grass/flowers when
attacking (see the options below). Default:
true.
text.autoconfig.simplefarming.option.ena:
Right-click fully grown crops with a hoe to
harvest and replant them. Consumes
durability. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simplefarming.option.gra:
Sharpness level a sword or axe needs to cut the
grass around its target and swing through grass.
Default: 1. Range: 1-5.

Chance in percent to hit a mob through grass
with Sharpness I; rises linearly up to the
Sharpness V value. Default: 10.

Chance in percent to hit a mob through grass
with Sharpness V. Default: 90.

Extra rings of blocks cut around the target per
Sweeping Edge level (basic area is 3x3).
Default: 1. Range: 0-3.
simplefarming.guide.page.1.title: Simple Farming
simplefarming.guide.page.1: Feather Falling protects farmland, Sharpness cuts grass, a hoe harvests and replants ripe crops. A sub-mod of Simple Quality of Life, also playable alone.
simplefarming.guide.page.2.title: Feather Falling farmland protection
simplefarming.guide.page.2: Feather Falling boots prevent trampling. This complements SimpleBuilding Breeze head protection. Enabled by preventFarmlandTrampleWithFeatherFalling, default true.
simplefarming.guide.page.3.title: Hoe harvest and replant
simplefarming.guide.page.3: Main-hand hoes harvest mature wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, and cocoa. One seed is taken from the actual loot; survival costs one durability.
simplefarming.guide.page.4.title: Hoe harvest and replant
simplefarming.guide.page.4: Server reach, world border, spawn protection, build rights, loader break vetoes, and a four-tick action limit are enforced.
simplefarming.guide.page.5.title: Cut through grass
simplefarming.guide.page.5: With Sharpness I or higher a sword or axe swings through grass and flowers:
simplefarming.guide.page.6.title: Cut through grass
simplefarming.guide.page.6: the chance to hit the mob behind them is 10 % at Sharpness I and rises linearly to 90 % at V (the outline of the plant disappears for a swing that passes).
simplefarming.guide.page.7.title: Cut through grass
simplefarming.guide.page.7: A hit cuts the vegetation in a 3x3 area around the target; every Sweeping Edge level adds a ring. Sneaking disables it. Loader break vetoes and the action cooldown apply. Options:
simplefarming.guide.page.8.title: Cut through grass
simplefarming.guide.page.8: grassCutMinSharpness, grassThroughMinPercent, grassThroughMaxPercent, grassSweepRadiusPerLevel; sharpnessCutsGrass switches it all off.
simplefarming.guide.page.9.title: Commands
simplefarming.guide.page.9: Permission level 2: /simplefarming farmlandProtect, hoeHarvest and sharpnessCut <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simplefarming.json.
simplefarming.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simplefarming.guide.page.10: /simplefarming config shows and changes every option of config/simplefarming.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once.
simplefarming.guide.page.11.title: Commands
simplefarming.guide.page.12.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simplefarming.guide.page.12: Playable alone (config/simplefarming.json). Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Farming".
simplefarming.guide.page.13.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simplefarming.guide.page.13: On the first start the old Simple QoL settings of this sub-mod are taken over once.
simplefarming.guide.page.14.title: Settings
simplefarming.guide.page.14: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
